summary.en: A family of efficient foundation language models trained on publicly available data
summary.zh: 在公开可用数据上训练的高效基础语言模型系列

description.en:
LLaMA introduced a family of 7B to 65B parameter foundation language models trained on publicly available datasets. The work emphasized that smaller models trained on more tokens could deliver strong inference-time efficiency and competitive benchmark performance.

The release gave researchers access to capable base models at several scales and accelerated work on adaptation, quantization and instruction tuning.
description.zh:
LLaMA 推出一组参数规模从 70 亿到 650 亿的基础语言模型，并在公开可用数据集上训练。该工作强调：让较小模型看到更多训练 token，可以兼顾较强基准表现与更高推理效率。

这次发布让研究者能够在多个规模上使用有能力的基础模型，并加速了适配、量化和指令微调研究。

role.en: First author of the LLaMA paper
